correctness.rationale: Reconstructed primitive-idempotent Peirce normalization without dividing by two, separated non-loop arrow reverse-direction maps from Leibniz maps, and determined characteristic-two loop-to-loop L² and central-component Lc channels. In the ordinary derivation subspace only local loop maps and s isolated single-loop diagonal images remain; subtracting gives the displayed formula. Loopless, one-loop dual numbers, disconnected components, arrows of both orientations and arbitrary characteristic were checked. An independently written field-linear coefficient-system verifier agreed for 12 small quivers over F2,F3,F5; this finite check supports, not replaces, the all-quiver structural proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete, naturally motivated defect invariant for finite radical-square-zero quiver algebras, measuring exactly when square-only Jordan maps fail Leibniz and including sharp graph rigidity conditions and finite-field ratios. The characteristic-two loop centrality is a structural obstruction not a gratuitous small example.

final_claim: For any finite directed multigraph Q, the quotient dimension between k-linear square-only Jordan derivations and derivations on kQ/J² is Σ_{u≠v}m_uv m_vu plus, precisely in characteristic 2, Σ_{u≠v}ell_u ell_v+L c−s; the statement includes the sharp rigidity criterion and finite-field map-count ratios.
limitations: Finite quivers, k-linear square-only Jordan maps, radical-square-zero quotients; not nonlinear maps, full path algebras or broader bound-quiver ideals.
residual_risks: Implicit recursive specialization of Li–van Wyk–Wei 2012 Proposition 3.2 may make the exact formula an easier known consequence than the presentation suggests.
